notes.title: Netveil is now FREE!!!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello silly people!!![/h3]

[h3]I have decided to make Netveil free to play after seeing your feedback and realising the game is too short to charge something for it. I probably should've done this sooner but oh well.[/h3]

[h2]You will now be able to enjoy the game without having to pay anything! YIPPIE!![/h2]
